title: xdrip api-secret correct url syntax
symptom: When using xDrip's local web service with an API secret set, requests like http://127.0.0.1:17580/status.json return 'Authentication failed - check api-secret', 'secret is required', and 'no secret supplied'. The service works without the secret.
cause: The API secret must be sent as a header, not as part of the URL (e.g., user:password@host syntax). The thread indicates that an API secret is not an authorization protocol that can be handled directly in the browser URL.
fix: Use a layer in between (e.g., an AJAX request with a JavaScript framework like jQuery) to set the 'api-secret' header. The secret should be the SHA1 hash in lowercase, as shown in the curl example: curl.exe -X DELETE -H "api-secret: 911eea185f5c758ac275687da8b7eab50ad720e5" -g https://...
evidence_quote: So, the api secret should be part of the header. I'm not sure how you are sending the requests, but something has to put the api-secret in the header.
